title: Visibility manifest
description: A machine-readable visibility manifest: path globs map to a TLP-derived label, assigned at intake. Rules are evaluated in listed order and the first matching glob wins; a path matched by no rule keeps the manifest default. Agents may raise the restriction; only the operator lowers it, as a signed manifest edit. See docs/VISIBILITY.md.

default.description: Label applied to paths matched by no rule.

rules.description: Path-glob rules; the first match in listed order wins.

glob.description: Path glob relative to the manifest root.

label.description: TLP 2.0-derived: RED never leaves the machine; AMBER (AMBER+STRICT) reaches trusted agents of the same operator only; GREEN is shareable within the declared community or pack; CLEAR is public.
